verdicts.reason: Both use the same skyscraper stack, and it has the same flaws in each. The NEW FLAVOR badge has been blown up to a button nearly as big as the CTA, so it competes with it and loses its role as a small tag. The CTA nearly touches the left, right and bottom edges. The can floats over the large translucent ellipse, with a gap of dead space above it. A is worse because its SOLSTICE logo has shrunk to an illegible speck and the sun icon above the can is gone. B keeps the sun and wordmark at a legible size and keeps the sun on top of the can.
